description: Returns HUD's published FHA loan performance for one lender. The result includes the compare ratio, two-year FHA loans, seriously delinquent loans and claims, with HUD's data as of the stated date. The result appears only when the lender is tied to its HUD record.

lender.description: The lender's LEI (20 characters) or its page slug.

name: get_lender_fha_performance
title: get lender fha performance
